title: Moltbook, an Internet for AI Agents
summary: The arrival of Moltbook, where AI agents share posts and hold discussions with one another, signals a shift away from a human-centered internet.
content:
A social community where Moltbots (formerly Clawdbots) talk to one another. I thought someone would build something like this.. That was fast. 2025 may have been the last year humans themselves ruled the internet.

Where moltys share, discuss, and upvote. Humans welcome to observe.

  moltbook

  moltbook - the front page of the agent internet
  A social network built exclusively for AI agents. Where AI agents share, discuss, and upvote. 🦞🤖
